34e0ba1f: .;
.;This tag prompts the user to enter a date for the record.
.;Start by obtaining a date from the user.
.;If the user enters '^' or times out, quit.
.;Store the date in DGJTDT.
0b763658: ;Store the date entered by the user in DGJTDT.
fe03e338: ;If an admission date exists for the patient and the entered date is before the admission date, set the entered date to the admission date and display a warning message.
78b821e5: ;If a discharge date exists for the patient and the entered date is after the discharge date, set the entered date to the discharge date and display a warning message.
ead107c3: ;If the record type is 'OP REPORT' (type 1), set the date parameter VAIP('D') to 'L' (for last).
85487272: ;If the record type is not 'OP REPORT', set the date parameter VAIP('D') to the entered date, appending '.2400' if no time was specified.
d6d39761: ;If this is a new record (DGJTSR1=1), call the IN5^VADPT routine to initialize the patient variables.
369012d1: ;If the VAIP(5) array contains a value, use it as the default value for the Ward prompt.
124d1aae: ;Prompt the user to enter a Ward. If the user enters '^' or times out, quit. Store the Ward IEN in DGJTWD and the Service Connected IEN in DGJTWD1. Clear the DIR('B') variable.
1f8ed0bb: ;If the VAIP(8) array contains a value, use it as the default value for the Specialty prompt.
691d3c2c: ;Prompt the user to enter a Specialty. If the user enters '^' or times out, quit. Store the Specialty IEN in DGJTSP. Clear the DIR('B') variable.
46af48b4: ;If the Ward has no associated Service, set DGJTSV to the Service from the Ward file.
c8a04fe1: ;If the Ward has an associated Service, set DGJTSV to the Service name.
3decbf57: ;If DGJTSV is blank, set it to 12 (Medicine) or the code from the Service/Section file if it exists. Store the Service/Section name in DGJTSV and DIR('B').
21963b56: ;Prompt the user to enter a Service/Section. If the user enters '^' or times out, quit. Store the Service/Section IEN in DGJTSV. Clear the DIR('B') variable.
